title: Banyuwangi appointed as pilot site for social empowerment programme
content:
Expert Staff at the Minister, Andy Kurniawan, said the appointment was linked to the success of Banyuwangi in piloting social protection digitalisation, a programme that has since expanded to 43 districts and cities across Indonesia.
"We cannot test this poverty alleviation model in many places at once, we have to focus on a specific location. That is why we chose Banyuwangi as a pilot model and we hope the success of the social protection programme is repeated here," Kurniawan said in a written statement received here on Saturday.
He explained the program will develop an empowerment model for beneficiary families.
By so, they no longer depend solely on social assistance, but capable to build economic capacity, own assets, gain access to business opportunities, and eventually become independent and graduate from social aid.
Related news: Ministry dispatches aid, prepares compensation for NTT quake victims
Kurniawan added the PPSE is an empowerment programme covering both social and economic aspects through individual and group approaches, carried out by strengthening capabilities, asset ownership, and access to improve the welfare of beneficiary families.
The programme targets beneficiary families who are receiving Family Hope Programme (PKH) aid, basic food assistance, and parents of students at Sekolah Rakyat.
Priority is given to the residents included in deciles one to four based on National Socioeconomic Data (DTSEN), aged 19 to 64, who have received PKH and/or basic food assistance for at least one year.
Beneficiary families that have already started small businesses will be prioritised, as the programme is directed at strengthening existing economic activity. It may also be extended to residents facing social risks that meet set criteria.

title: Retired footballers undertake health screening
content:
Sports
Retired footballers undertake health screening
‘Zebi & Friends,’ a group of retired footballers, on Saturday organised a health screening exercise at Osu in partnership with Health Enhancement and Access Link (HEAL).
About 25 members of the association benefited from tests including blood sugar, cholesterol, kidney and liver function.
Tests on full blood count and prostate cancer screening attracted discounted rates.
The HEAL medical team advised members to adopt healthy lifestyles and undergo regular medical check-ups, particularly as they advance in age.
The exercise formed part of efforts by the group to promote preventive healthcare and the wellbeing of its members.
BY TIMES SPORTS REPORTER

title: BRUCE PEARL: Conservatives are attacking the very college sports bill that protects women
content:
Men don’t belong in women’s sports. That isn’t complicated, but some conservative influencers and interest groups are allowing it to become complicated through careless claims about legislation designed to protect college athletics.
I spent nearly five decades coaching college basketball. I know the difference between winning a possession and winning the game. Conservatives now face a similar choice: We can chase applause by attacking allies and mischaracterizing the bill, or we can unite around the facts and win the larger fight for women, fairness and the future of college sports.
Some organizations and women’s-sports advocates claim the Protect College Sports Act would "gut" Title IX or invalidate state laws that reserve women’s teams for women. They are wrong. The text says the opposite.
REPORTER'S NOTEBOOK: COLLEGE SPORTS BILL ENTERS LEGISLATIVE 'RED ZONE' AS SEASON KICKS OFF
Section 127 explicitly states that nothing in the bill will "override, modify, or amend" Title IX. Female athletes would retain their current legal protections and ability to bring sex-discrimination claims. Section 120 also protects athletes, employees and others from retaliation for reporting discrimination or participating in Title IX proceedings.
I spent nearly five decades coaching college basketball. I know the difference between winning a possession and winning the game. Conservatives now face a similar choice: We can chase applause by attacking allies and mischaracterizing the bill, or we can unite around the facts.
Critics also claim the bill would erase state laws keeping men out of women’s sports. It would not. The legislation establishes national standards for Division I and Division II competition on limited eligibility questions, including academics, professional status, legal violations, age and years of eligibility. It neither creates a federal right for men to enter women’s competitions nor pre-empts state laws establishing sex-based athletic categories.
The bill does not expressly create a federal right for biological males to compete in women’s sports, and Section 127 states that nothing in the bill overrides, modifies or amends Title IX. Critics seem to be grasping at anything and eager to disregard the Title IX provisions here. Especially since the Supreme Court ruled in June that schools may keep men out of women’s sports.
It also requires governing bodies to enforce rules related to state and federal law and allows individuals to sue when the law is violated.
CONGRESS MUST FIX THE PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT BEFORE GIRLS PAY THE PRICE
The bill also gives schools a powerful incentive to invest in women’s and Olympic sports. It creates a $22.5 million athlete-retention fund and allows schools to unlock up to an additional $5 million through eligible NIL investments in women’s, Olympic and non-revenue sports. A school seeking the full $27.5 million retention allowance would first need to invest $5 million in those sports. That is an ingenious way to ensure continued investment in programs that might otherwise be left behind.
And every year Congress waits, the financial pressure on college athletics grows, and the programs with the fewest resources become even more vulnerable. My 2025 Final Four team had a total NIL budget of approximately $4 million. By the 2027 Final Four, some teams could be operating with budgets approaching $30 million.
Conservatives should debate legislation, demand improvements and scrutinize every line. But facts must guide us. Too many Washington organizations would rather score points against perceived rivals than secure lasting victories for women and college athletes.
Outrage is easy; turning shared principles into law is harder. Infighting only helps the left, which has spent years undermining Title IX while conservatives battle over legislation that expressly preserves it. If we can’t unite and get this done, we will lose college sports as we know them, and women’s and Olympic sports will continue to be among the first casualties.
The stakes extend beyond Title IX, and the crisis is no longer theoretical. Thirty-two Division I Olympic-sports programs were cut between the announcement of the House settlement and May 2025. WRAL reported that more than 40 Division I Olympic-sports programs were cut between May 2024 and July 2025, even though 75% of American Olympians in 2024 competed in collegiate athletics. NCAA data
Even the University of Arkansas, backed by SEC resources, announced plans to eliminate its tennis programs before donors intervened to save them. If programs at schools like Arkansas are vulnerable, imagine the danger facing smaller schools, women’s teams and non-revenue sports nationwide.
CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION
Credit where credit is due: Sens. Ted Cruz, R-Texas, and Eric Schmitt, R-Mo., and others have stepped up to move this legislation forward. President Trump has also led from the front by restoring the biological meaning of sex in federal policy, taking action to save college sports and backing this bill. Now, those who claim to support the America First movement should get in the game, help Congress finish the job and deliver this win for women and college athletes.
Congress now has the opportunity to take important steps to stabilize college sports, support educational opportunities for young women and men, and provide protections for the uniquely American experience of intercollegiate athletics.

There is broad agreement that college sports cannot go on with no meaningful guardrails around eligibility, transfer policy and NIL oversight. The Protect College Sports Act is an important step in the right direction, and Congress needs to keep the positive momentum moving forward.
Winning the point may feel good. Winning the war matters more.

title: Für Neun- bis Zehnjährige: Was Eltern über die neue U-Untersuchung wissen müssen
content:
Für Neun- bis Zehnjährige : Was Eltern über die neue U-Untersuchung wissen müssen
Eine neue Vorsorgeuntersuchung für Neun- bis Zehnjährige soll künftig als Kassenleistung angeboten werden. Was steckt dahinter? Antworten auf die wichtigsten Fragen.
Neun- bis Zehnjährige sollen künftig eine neue Vorsorgeuntersuchung, bekannt als U-Untersuchung, beim Kinderarzt als Kassenleistung bekommen. Der Gemeinsame Bundesausschuss (G-BA), der festlegt, welche medizinischen Leistungen gesetzlich Krankenversicherte in Anspruch nehmen können, hat die sogenannte U10 beschlossen. Ein Überblick.
Was genau wird bei der U10 untersucht?
Untersucht werden sollen insbesondere ein mögliches Übergewicht, die körperliche Aktivität, die Bildschirmzeit und psychische Auffälligkeiten. „Speziell für Kinder im Alter zwischen 9 und 10 Jahren weisen Studienergebnisse auf besondere Risiken hin“, teilte G-BA-Mitglied Bernhard van Treeck mit. Zu viel Handyzeit etwa könne zu Sprachentwicklungs- und Konzentrationsstörungen führen. Bewegungsmangel könne Übergewicht begünstigen.
Vorgesehen sei eine ausführliche Anamnese, bei der etwa die Eltern zu bestimmten Krankheitsrisiken und Belastungen innerhalb der Familie befragt würden. Neu in der U10 sei außerdem ein Fragebogen zur gesundheitsbezogenen Lebensqualität, die das psychische Wohlbefinden des Kindes umfasst. Der Fragebogen wird vorab von den Eltern ausgefüllt.
Die U10 ermögliche, zu untersuchen, ob sich das Kind altersgerecht entwickele oder es Hinweise auf Erkrankungen beziehungsweise besondere Risiken gebe. Auch eine Impfberatung steht laut G-BA auf dem Plan, vor allem um die Quoten der HPV-Impfung (Humane Papillomviren) zu erhöhen. Die Viren können Krebs auslösen.
Der G-BA hat zusätzlich beschlossen, die Befunde der Jugenduntersuchung J1 im Kinderuntersuchungsheft (Gelbes Heft) festzuhalten.
Ab wann gibt es die U10?
Bis Kinderarztpraxen die U10 als Kassenleistung anbieten, wird es noch einige Monate dauern. Zunächst müssen die Beschlüsse dem Bundesgesundheitsministerium vorgelegt werden. Gibt es keine Einwände, werden sie im Bundesanzeiger veröffentlicht und treten in Kraft. Danach wird innerhalb von sechs Monaten festgelegt, wie viel Geld Ärztinnen und Ärzte für die Untersuchung bekommen. Erst dann kann die U10 als Kassenleistung angeboten werden.
Welche Untersuchungen wurden bislang von den Kassen gezahlt?
Bislang gab es nach Angaben des Bundesinstituts für öffentliche Gesundheit (BIÖG) für Kinder in Deutschland folgende Untersuchungen als Kassenleistung: U1 bis U3 finden in den ersten Tagen und Wochen nach der Geburt statt, U4 bis U6 bis zu Vollendung des ersten Lebensjahres, U7 bis U9 bis kurz nach dem 5. Geburtstag. Außerdem wird die Jugenduntersuchung J1 von den Krankenkassen gezahlt, die im Alter von zwölf bis 14 Jahren erfolgt.
Gab es nicht bereits eine U10 und eine U11?
Ja, als zusätzliche Vorsorgeuntersuchung gibt es schon länger eine U10 und auch eine U11. Allerdings wurden die zwei Untersuchungen bislang nicht von allen Krankenkassen bezahlt, wie der Berufsverband der Kinder- und Jugendärzt*innen aufklärt. Die U10 galt demnach bislang für Sieben- bis Achtjährige, die U11 für Neun- bis Zehnjährige. Zudem gibt es eine J2 für Jugendliche im Alter von 16 bis 17 Jahren, die allerdings auch nur von einigen Krankenkassen gezahlt wird.
Wie wird die Aufnahme der U10 in die Regelversorgung begründet?
Laut G-BA gab es zwischen der letzten Vorsorgeuntersuchung im Kindesalter, der U9, und der ersten im Jugendalter, der J1, bisher eine zu große Lücke. Die U9 findet um den 5. Geburtstag herum statt, bei der J1 sind die Kinder schon zwölf bis 14 Jahre alt.
Hinzu kommt, dass die Teilnahme an der J1 und der J2 deutlich geringer ist, als bei den Untersuchungen im Kindesalter, wie Experten betonen. „Während die U1 bis U9 wahrscheinlich aufgrund der kürzeren Zeitabstände fast vollständig wahrgenommen werden, erreicht die J1 aktuell nicht einmal die Hälfte der Jugendlichen“, teilte die Präsidentin der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Kinder- und Jugendmedizin, Ursula Felderhoff-Müser, mit. „Wir verlieren also ausgerechnet in dieser prägenden Phase den regelmäßigen kinder- und jugendärztlichen Kontakt.“
Wie schätzen Expertinnen den Nutzen ein?
Das Alter von neun und zehn Jahren sei ein günstiger Zeitpunkt, weil der Wachstumsschub in der Pubertät noch nicht begonnen habe, meinte Felderhoff-Müser. Die Gewichtsentwicklung und auffällige Verhaltensmuster ließen sich gegebenenfalls noch beeinflussen. „In Bezug auf die psychische Gesundheit kann ein zusätzlicher ärztlicher Kontakt helfen, beginnende Auffälligkeiten wie Angst, Essstörungssymptome, ADHS-Verdacht und soziale Rückzugstendenzen früher zu erfassen.“
Eva Möhler, Direktorin der Klinik für Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie, Psychosomatik und Psychotherapie am Universitätsklinikum des Saarlandes, sieht großes Potenzial, betonte aber, man dürfe eine einzelne Untersuchung nicht überschätzen. Bei Adipositas etwa sei es wichtig zu schauen, wie dem Kind im Anschluss weiter geholfen werden könne, etwa in Form einer Beratung.
Wichtig sei auch, die Kinder nicht vorschnell zu verurteilen. „Also nicht ‚Du spielst zu viel am Handy‘ oder‚ Du bist zu dick‘', sondern eher mit offenen Fragen die Perspektive des Kindes einholen: ‚Wie geht es dir?‘ oder ‚Was könnte dir helfen?‘“, so Möhler.
Ärztinnen und Ärzte hoffen, mit der Aufnahme der U10 in die Regelvorsorge künftig mehr Kinder aus sozial benachteiligten Familien zu erreichen. Damit das klappt, brauche es unbedingt ein aktives Einladungs- und Erinnerungssystem sowie mehrsprachige und leicht verständliche Informationen, forderte Möhler.

title: From tropical forests to desert shores: Thailand and Qatar join hands on mangrove restoration
content:
Few would expect Thailand and Qatar to become partners in mangrove restoration. One is defined by its tropical coastlines and dense mangrove forests; the other by desert landscapes and the waters of the Arabian Gulf. Yet it is precisely this contrast that has created a remarkable opportunity for cooperation on environmental sustainability. That vision is now becoming a reality.
Through the facilitation of the Thai embassy in Doha, senior Qatari researchers recently undertook a five-day working visit to Thailand’s mangrove conservation sites, laying the groundwork for a mangrove restoration project in Qatar that will involve a Thai expert as a consultant later in 2026.
The visit was organised by the embassy in Doha in June, in cooperation with the Thailand International Cooperation Agency (TICA), Thailand’s principal agency for international development cooperation. The programme brought two senior researchers from Qatar University’s Environmental Science Centre (ESC) - Prof Dr Jassim al-Khayat and Prof Dr Vethamony Ponnumony - to visit Thailand’s coastal conservation sites, research centres, and government agencies responsible for marine and coastal resources.
According to the embassy, this visit marks the first major step toward deeper cooperation on sustainable development and mangrove restoration between Thailand and Qatar. This year, a mangrove expert from Thailand has been selected to serve as a consultant for a mangrove restoration project in Qatar, representing an important milestone in bilateral cooperation between the two countries in the field of sustainable development.
This progress did not happen by chance. For more than a year, the embassy in Doha has worked to position Thailand as a trusted partner for Qatar on environmental sustainability, laying the foundation for practical collaboration that benefits both countries.
The foundation for this initiative was laid in 2025 through two embassy-led visits by Thai experts to Qatar. The first visit was held from February 16 to 19, 2025, and included a seminar entitled 'Mangrove Conservation in Qatar: Towards a Practicable Action Plan', co-hosted with the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MECC), ESC, and Earthna Centre for a Sustainable Future on February 17, 2025 at Qatar Foundation.
The delegation also visited mangrove conservation sites, agricultural plantations, and eco-tourism locations in Al-Thakira and Al-Ruwais to observe conservation efforts, exchange expertise, and explore potential areas for collaboration. The second visit was held from April 22 to 23, 2025, and coincided with the Earthna Summit 2025, which the embassy, in collaboration with MECC, ESC, and Earthna, co-hosted a seminar entitled 'From Local to Global: Thailand’s Sustainability and Eco-Tourism Journeys', as an official side event of the summit.
The seminar highlighted Thailand’s sustainability frameworks, emphasising its globally recognised eco-tourism models, environmental conservation efforts, and community-driven development initiatives. The embassy also organised an exhibition at the Earthna Village 2025 to showcase Thailand’s journey towards sustainable development through the display of upcycled and community products from Thai mangrove forests, highlighting the achievements of community-driven development while demonstrating how local communities contribute to sustainable development.
The recent visit to Thailand in June brought the ESC delegation to meet with the institutions responsible for Thailand’s conservation ecosystem. In Phetchaburi Province on the western coast of the Gulf of Thailand, the delegation visited the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources’ Mangrove Resource Management Centre, observing mangrove nurseries and restoration techniques, as well as community-led value addition projects that generate sustainable livelihoods.
The group also visited the Laem Phak Bia Environmental Research and Development Project under Royal Initiative, a research centre recognised as a regional model for integrated coastal management and circular economy practices. In Chonburi Province on the eastern coast of the Gulf of Thailand, the delegation visited the Royal Thai Navy Sea Turtle Conservation Centre, where they explored an approach to marine animal conservation that engages public and military institutions with the private sector to protect endangered sea turtles and other marine species.
The visit also included policy discussions with senior representatives from TICA, the Department of Marine and Coastal Resources (DMCR), Kasetsart University, and the Royal Thai Navy. The discussions focused on exchanging knowledge about mangrove restoration protocols, marine resource conservation, and how ecotourism policy frameworks can be structured as conservation tools rather than as tools for resource exploitation.
The embassy noted that the visit delivered tangible outcomes, as both parties committed to strengthening institutional networks and academic cooperation. Although Thailand and Qatar face different environmental challenges, both countries share a common aspiration towards environmental conservation and sustainable development, a shared vision that underpins the growing partnership.
Thailand’s best practices in coastal resource management and mangrove conservation provide opportunities for academic cooperation with Qatar, which has already achieved remarkable progress in various environmental conservation and restoration projects under the Qatar National Vision 2030 and the Third National Development Strategy. Qatar brings considerable strengths to the partnership, namely strong institutional management and abundant natural resources that offer significant potential for conservation-led development. Against this backdrop, Thailand’s experience and expertise offer an accessible model that could be a beneficial addition to Qatar’s ongoing efforts.
As Thailand and Qatar continue to strengthen their partnership, the embassy said this initiative demonstrates how countries with vastly different environments can work together to address shared global challenges. What began as an exchange of expertise has evolved into a practical partnership - one that promises lasting benefits for environmental conservation, scientific cooperation, and sustainable development in both countries.

title: Cercanías estrena trenes en Madrid, Rodalies espera hacerlo a final de año
content:
Cercanías estrena trenes en Madrid, Rodalies espera hacerlo a final de año
Movilidad
Los nuevos convoyes fabricados por Stadler empiezan a prestar servicio en la capital mientras los de Alstom siguen pendientes del permiso de seguridad ferroviaria
Los usuarios de Rodalies que vuelvan de las vacaciones se encontrarán las mismas limitaciones de velocidad y problemas en la red ferroviaria que había un mes antes. En cambio, el retorno a la rutina de los viajeros de Cercanías en Madrid va acompañado de novedades importantes, con nuevos trenes circulando por la capital española.
Esta semana se estrenan en la línea C7 las dos primeras unidades salidas de la fábrica de Stadler en Albuixech, una de 100 metros y otra de 200, ambas con vagones de dos pisos. Son convoyes con más pantallas de información y una capacidad un 20% superior, además de más puertas sin escalones –lo que agiliza la subida y bajada de pasajeros– y espacios para personas con movilidad reducida, bicicletas y carritos infantiles. A lo largo de los próximos meses se irán incorporando más trenes en el resto de las líneas del núcleo de Cercanías en Madrid hasta completar el pedido formado por 79 nuevas unidades.
El tren de Alstom para Rodalies está pendiente de la homologación de seguridad para poder entrar en servicio
En Catalunya habrá que esperar a finales de año, en el mejor de los casos. Los nuevos trenes de Rodalies no son del mismo fabricante, sino de Alstom y, en este caso, los plazos se han ido retrasando. Las pruebas de validación se vieron afectadas por la crisis de Rodalies a principios de año y por unos defectos en la fabricación que obligaron a hacer pequeños cambios en el diseño de los trenes, lo que le ha costado unas sonadas reprimendas públicas por parte del ministro de Transportes, Óscar Puente.
El pasado mes de mayo, con todo resuelto, la empresa fabricante entregó el dossier de homologación a la Agencia Española de Seguridad Ferroviaria (Aesf) y los dos primeros trenes preparados para circular salieron de la fábrica en junio. En las últimas semanas empiezan a acumularse las nuevas unidades en las vías de la planta de Alstom en el Vallès, de donde tendrán que salir por carretera, ya que las obras de la R3 impiden la utilización de la conexión ferroviaria.
El compromiso del fabricante francés es entregar antes de final de año las primeras 14 unidades del pedido de 201 trenes, de los cuales 72 se quedan en Catalunya y el resto irán al resto de España. También se esperan para mediados del año que viene nuevos trenes de CAF para los regionales.
La incorporación progresiva de los nuevos trenes supone una reorganización de la flota de Renfe. El primer movimiento son más de 40 trenes Civia de entre 14 y 23 años –con una larga vida por delante– que serán derivados de Madrid al núcleo de Cercanías de Valencia. Aunque supone un rejuvenecimiento de la flota, el traslado de trenes de “segunda mano” ha provocado una fuerte bronca entre el Ministerio de Transportes y el Gobierno valenciano.

title: 20 trung tâm y tế ở Cần Thơ thành bệnh viện đa khoa khu vực
content:
Ngày 22-8, thông tin từ Sở Y tế TP Cần Thơ cho biết UBND thành phố đã ban hành quyết định về việc tổ chức lại các trung tâm y tế khu vực thuộc Sở Y tế.
Các trung tâm được tổ chức lại thành mô hình bệnh viện là: Bệnh viện Đa khoa khu vực Bình Thủy, Cái Răng, Thới Lai, Ô Môn, Thốt Nốt, Vĩnh Thạnh, Vị Thủy, Long Mỹ, Phụng Hiệp, Châu Thành, Châu Thành A, Cù Lao Dung, Kế Sách, Sóc Trăng, Vĩnh Châu, Ngã Năm, Mỹ Xuyên, Long Phú, Mỹ Tú và Thạnh Trị.
Theo quyết định, các bệnh viện đa khoa khu vực sau khi tổ chức lại có tư cách pháp nhân, con dấu riêng, được mở tài khoản tại Kho bạc Nhà nước theo quy định.
Các chức năng, nhiệm vụ và nhân sự về công tác y tế dự phòng thuộc các trung tâm y tế khu vực trước đây được chuyển về trạm y tế trực thuộc UBND xã, phường để quản lý và làm nhiệm vụ theo hướng dẫn chuyên môn của Bộ Y tế.
PGS.TS Hoàng Quốc Cường - Giám đốc Sở Y tế TP Cần Thơ - nhấn mạnh rằng chậm nhất là đến ngày 1-9 tới 20 bệnh viện khu vực này sẽ công bố hoạt động theo mô hình mới.
Việc tổ chức lại nhằm kiện toàn mô hình hoạt động của các đơn vị sự nghiệp công lập thuộc ngành y tế. Đồng thời phân định rõ ràng về chức năng nhiệm vụ trong khám, chữa bệnh và y tế dự phòng.
Tiến tới các bệnh viện khu vực này phải tổ chức lại với đầy đủ các phòng chức năng của một bệnh viện, hoạt động khám chữa bệnh cho người dân. Đồng thời học cách tiếp cận, tìm hướng đi để thu hút người dân địa phương đến khám điều trị và tiến tới là bệnh viện tự chủ nhóm 2, ông Cường nói.
Theo quyết định, chủ tịch UBND xã, phường có trách nhiệm chỉ đạo tiếp nhận chức năng, nhiệm vụ và nhân sự khối dự phòng từ các trung tâm y tế khu vực về 103 trạm y tế xã, phường. Theo mô hình mới mỗi trạm y tế sẽ có 30 nhân sự, TP Cần Thơ sẽ có khoảng 3.000 nhân viên y tế tại các trạm y tế.
Trước mắt, các bệnh viện khu vực được xác định là đơn vị sự nghiệp công lập, tự đảm bảo một phần chi thường xuyên (tự chủ nhóm 3), trừ một số đơn vị thuộc nhóm 2. Được tổ chức dựa trên các phòng chuyên môn có sẵn.
Bệnh viện Đa khoa khu vực Long Mỹ có 5 phòng chức năng, với 15 khoa chuyên môn; Bệnh viện Đa khoa khu vực Ô Môn và Thốt Nốt có 4 phòng chức năng, 15 khoa chuyên môn.

title: I was trapped in a cave for 54 hours but made it my mission to get back underground
content:
I was trapped in a cave for 54 hours but made it my mission to get back underground
- Published
A man trapped for 54 hours in the UK's longest cave rescue said it was his mission to "get back underground" as soon as possible.
George Linnane from Bristol was exploring deep in the Ogof Ffynnon Ddu cave system in Bannau Brycheiniog National Park - also known as the Brecon Beacons - with friends when he fell, breaking a leg, his jaw and three ribs.
"I always wanted to get back underground. I kind of made it my mission. I decided this very early on whilst I was still in the hospital," said the 43-year-old.
After nine months of recovery and slowly building up his physical fitness, Linnane was able to return to his adventurous hobby, even revisiting the cave where he fell in November 2021.
Describing being trapped underground, he said: "I was in survival mode. At points during that I thought I might not make it.
"One second I was caving, the next minute, the world went mad."
Linnane said he felt "lucky to be alive" and "very lucky" to still have his right leg but was always eager to return to caving, despite injuries sustained from his fall.
"When people think of caving, they think of small passages and crawling and misery," he said.
"And that's really not what it's about. We do that stuff. But we do it to get to the good stuff, pretty amazing things that 99.9% of the population will never see.
"It's another world down there. It's like being on the moon or another planet."
Linnane said the excursion was meant to be a five or six-hour "easy" trip.
But at some point, deep in the complex of 61km (38 miles) of twists and turns, he suddenly felt his "legs whirling around in mid-air, arms grabbing for something" before things went blank.
When he came round, he said it was obvious the bottom half of his leg was broken and some of his teeth were missing.
Much of his body felt uncomfortable but he was not fully aware of the seriousness of his injuries.
He also sustained three broken ribs, a dislocated clavicle with his collarbone pulling away from his ribcage, a lacerated spleen, a collapsed lung and a broken scaphoid in his wrist.
Ten separate teams from around the UK banded together to get Linnane to safety, with 250 volunteers underground and more than 50 on the surface to support the rescue.
"There was a lot going on," Linnane said.
"I think some people were underground for 12 hours at a time. I've been underground for that length of time and more myself and it's quite a long time to be underground."
While the rescue was under way, Linnane asked for messages to be sent on his behalf.
"My car was meant to be going in for a MOT so I wanted a message to be sent to the MOT guy saying 'don't take my car because my partner is going to be needing that'," he said.
"I did also try to send out an 'I love you' to my partner as well."
Asked what it felt like when he reached the surface, he told the BBC World Service:, external "It felt like Wales. It was wet and windy.
"Emotionally I was really pleased to get out of there."
Despite knowing he wanted to return underground following his rescue and recovery, Linnane needed to learn to eat and walk again first.
He said at the beginning of his recovery his progress was "very, very slow".
"You can't just look at the end because it seems very far away and kind of unobtainable, like it's never going to come," he said.
"I just wanted to be able to eat my Christmas dinner with my teeth rather than sticking it in a blender.
"It took four weeks of literally training my jaw to chew."
Linnane began learning to walk again, starting by trying to reach the end of his driveway and back, before heading just a few hundred metres up the road.
After just over four months, Linnane was able to get into a swimming pool, slowly building up his fitness.
Six months after the accident, he was able to return to scuba diving, a hobby that led him to discover his love of caving.
"Nine months later I went back underground for the first time and I just kind of took it from there," he said.
"It's what I do and what makes me happy. And I know that whilst something bad did happen to me, the chances of it happening again is very, very low."
Linnane said he also wanted to get "strong enough" to be able to join South and Mid Wales Cave Rescue Team, which co-ordinated the rescue operation that returned him to safety.
"I wanted to be able to help the next poor soul this happens to," he said.
"Caving is a very safe sport, generally speaking, for people that know what they're doing.
"It's as safe as crossing a road. But things do happen occasionally. And when they do, there is only one team of people, one type of person that is going to get you out of there.
"The fire service can't do it, mountain rescue can't do it. The only people that can do it is other cavers, because they're the only people with the skill set to do it.
"Cavers rescue cavers."

title: WLAK THE TALK: WHO Africa Health Leaders Take Health Commitments to the Streets of Addis Ababa
content:
WLAK THE TALK: WHO Africa Health Leaders Take Health Commitments to the Streets of Addis Ababa
Addis Ababa, August 23, 2026 (FMC) — Participants of the 76th Session of the World Health Organization (WHO) Regional Committee for Africa (RC76) took part in a symbolic health walk on Sunday from the Adwa Victory Memorial to Meskel Square in Addis Ababa, turning the “Walk the Talk” message into action while promoting physical activity and healthier lifestyles across Africa.
Ethiopia’s Health Minister Mekdes Daba, African health ministers, senior government officials, WHO leaders and prominent athletes, including Ethiopian Athletics Federation President Sileshi Sihine, participated in the event.
The initiative sought to translate health policies and commitments into practical action by encouraging people to incorporate regular physical activity into their daily lives and raising public awareness about preventing non-communicable diseases.
The walk began at the Adwa Victory Memorial, a landmark symbolizing Ethiopia’s historic victory and African resistance to colonialism, and proceeded through Addis Ababa’s pedestrian routes before concluding at Meskel Square.
Organizers emphasized that regular physical activity plays a vital role in reducing the risk of non-communicable diseases, including diabetes, hypertension and cardiovascular diseases, while contributing to healthier and more active communities.
The event also underscored Africa’s collective commitment to improving public health and the importance of moving beyond policy discussions toward tangible, everyday health practices.
The 76th Session of the WHO Regional Committee for Africa is scheduled to take place in Addis Ababa from August 24 to 28, 2026, bringing together more than 600 delegates, including health ministers and senior officials from the WHO African Region’s 47 member states, global health leaders, development partners, donors and WHO representatives.
During the five-day session, participants will assess progress toward regional health goals and deliberate on new strategies and resolutions.
The session is also expected to identify collective actions to strengthen health systems, advance universal health coverage, enhance health security and improve emergency preparedness across the continent.
The gathering is expected to provide a major platform for African countries and global health partners to deepen continental health cooperation and advance practical solutions to some of Africa’s most pressing health challenges.

title: Colorado has provided the blueprint for integrating community power
content:
Mary Rafferty is the executive director of Common Charge, a coalition of nonprofits, businesses and consumers that advocates for more affordable and distributed energy.
At a time when many states are scrambling to find solutions to provide affordable energy amidst rising demand and electricity prices, Colorado is leading the way in solutions, including creating pathways to deploy distributed solar and storage resources. The state is prioritizing these distributed energy resources for their ability to be constructed and connected on faster timelines while providing affordable, dependable grid capacity.
Like states across the country, Colorado is facing rising bills and increasing energy demand. The average energy bill in Colorado has grown more than 27% in the last five years. At the same time, energy demand in the state is expected to surge 57% over the next two decades. Community scale solar and battery storage are a cornerstone of Colorado’s solution - solving the energy needs of individual communities now through an innovative, new dispatchable distribution program.
Dispatchable distributed energy works by co-locating midscale batteries and solar, turning them into an around-the-clock solution, storing energy when the sun is up and releasing it when it’s needed most. This is particularly useful for managing local energy demand spikes with right-sized solutions. The mid-scale size of these projects (typically 1-5 MWs) enables them to be built closer to communities and plugged directly into the local distribution grid, avoiding costly transmission build out and allowing projects to be built closer to where the grid is most congested.
Last year, the Colorado Public Utilities Commission approved a new Dispatchable Distributed Generation program (DDG) requiring the state's larger investor-owned utilities — mainly Xcel Energy — to buy at least 50 megawatts a year of community scale solar co-located with mid-scale batteries in 2026 and 2027. Just a few weeks ago, Xcel Energy issued the nation's first competitive solicitation under the program.
The truly unique aspect of this program is that it’s built on a competitive procurement process that evaluates projects based on the value they provide to the electric system. Rather than making decisions based on generation cost alone, utilities will factor a resource’s geographical benefits and its overall impact on the grid.
Here’s how it works: Xcel identifies where additional capacity will provide the greatest value through its resource planning process, and developers submit project proposals that meet those needs with dispatchable resources. Projects that directly match needs are selected to provide affordable electrons to areas that require them, with regulators overseeing a fair process that evaluates the impact to the grid and customer value.
By leveraging each participant’s strength, distributed solar and storage can provide flexibility, fill near-term capacity gaps, and reduce peak demand pressures, while larger infrastructure projects continue to move forward to support future energy growth.
In addition, by opening the market to competitive providers of solar, storage, and other distributed energy resources, the state is tapping private investment and competitive market forces to deliver new grid capacity years faster and at a lower cost to customers than utility-owned infrastructure alone can provide.
Perhaps the program's greatest strength, however, is that it was built with speed in mind. Utilities and communities facing resource constraints cannot afford to spend years waiting for frameworks to develop to drive deployment. DDG tackles that issue head-on, removing barriers that slow projects, including interconnection timelines.
The program was crafted by an unusually broad coalition of stakeholders, including Xcel Energy, the Colorado Energy Office, consumer advocates, environmental organizations and solar and storage developers. The process produced a realistic program that balances the needs of communities with the operational and market realities of utilities and developers.
While not all states will replicate Colorado’s program, the principles they were built on should serve as a guide to develop their own frameworks.
- States should recognize dispatchable distributed resources as legitimate capacity assets that address the immediate needs of the grid, keeping costs low for consumers and power reliable.
- Distributed energy projects should be able to compete based on the measurable value they provide to the electric system, including avoided generation, transmission and distribution costs where applicable.
- Competition and planning should work in concert: Utilities determine the needs of the grid. Developers put forth the best solutions to meet those needs. Regulators ensure fairness and consumer protection. Everyone has a role to play.
The timing could not be more important. In most states across the country, customers are seeing energy costs increase while grid operators are trying to manage significant growth in demand. While regulators and utilities grapple with trying to address these daunting challenges through traditional mechanisms, a critical piece of the puzzle lies before them.
Colorado has provided the blueprint. It’s time for states to build for their communities and local economies. And distributed energy resources are powerful tools ready to be taken out of the kit.

title: Bart, Guido, Jeaninne en Bernard van woonzorgcentrum 't Hoge genieten op eerste rij van Willy Sommers op Kamping Kitsch in Kortrijk
content:
Bart, Guido, Jeaninne en Bernard van woonzorgcentrum 't Hoge in Kortrijk zijn vandaag de eregasten op Kamping Kitsch in Kortrijk. Samen met hun begeleiders mogen ze het optreden van Willy Sommers op de eerste rij meemaken. "Het is al 50 jaar geleden dat ik me nog zó heb geamuseerd", zegt Guido.
Bart, Guido, Jeaninne en Bernard van woonzorgcentrum 't Hoge genieten op eerste rij van Willy Sommers op Kamping Kitsch in Kortrijk
Het geluk van Bart, Guido, Jeaninne en Bernard van woonzorgcentrum 't Hoge in Kortijk kan niet op vandaag. Zij mogen naar Willy Sommers gaan kijken op Kamping Kitsch in Kortijk.
In volle ornaat - zoals dat hoort - kwamen de bewoners vanmiddag met hun begeleiders aan op het festival om er een mooie dag te beleven.
"Het is een zotte ingeving geweest om de bewoners naar hier mee te nemen", zegt Ilse Flockmans, directeur van het woonzorgcentrum. "Uiteraard hebben we alles goed voorbereid en zijn de families van de bewoners ook op de hoogte. Iedereen heeft er heel veel zin in."
En dat ze er zin in hebben, dat beamen de bewoners zelf. "Heel tof, het is mijn eerste keer hier op Kamping Kitsch", zegt Bart. "Het is jaren geleden dat ik nog naar een festival ben geweest. Ik amuseer me."
"Het is al 50 jaar geleden dat ik me nog zo geamuseerd heb", roept Guido enthousiast. "Ik heb hier al veel schone dingen gezien. Ik kijk mijn ogen uit."
Voor Jeaninne is het zelfs een primeur: "Ik ben nog nooit op een festival geweest. Hier lopen veel schone mensen rond. Dat is leuk om te zien", zegt ze.
Front seats
De 4 bewoners krijgen front seats bij Willy Sommers. En ook daar zijn ze goed op voorbereid. "We hebben de muziek van Willy Sommers al een aantal keren opgezet in de gangen, zodat ze de teksten een beetje kennen. Ze zullen de liedjes zeker kunnen meezingen", lacht Flockmans.
Niet alleen voor de bewoners, ook voor de begeleiders is het een feestelijke dag. "Beiretof hè", zegt begeleidster Jorunn enthousiast. "Ik had normaal verlof, maar dit wilde ik niet missen. Iedereen is zich zo aan het amuseren, meer hebben we niet nodig", zegt ze nog.

title: Protect Sandia Mountain, our church
content:
FOR CENTURIES UPON CENTURIES, the people of the Pueblo of Sandia have lived in relationship with Sandia Mountain and the Rio Grande in what is now known as New Mexico. Even when our lives were at risk during incursions by Spanish, Mexican, and American governments, we cared for the lands and the waters. And we prayed for the health of our communities and the world around us all.
Sacred to our community since time immemorial, Sandia Mountain is our church, our protector and our source of well-being. It is also home to wildlife and important ecosystems, and a source of beauty and recreation for hundreds of thousands of people who live in and visit the Middle Rio Grande Valley.
Today, we ask lawmakers and members of the public to respect our culture, traditional knowledge and sovereignty — and to support our efforts to further protect Sandia Mountain, especially in today’s rapidly changing and unpredictable world.
“We ask lawmakers and members of the public to respect our culture, traditional knowledge and sovereignty.”
Congress should transfer land within the T’uf Shur Bien Preservation Area from the U.S. Forest Service, within the U.S. Department of Agriculture, to the Bureau of Indian Affairs, within the Department of the Interior.
We appreciate the work of local Forest Service employees who have done their best to protect this special area through changing political administrations. Yet we have all seen the litter and graffiti, deferred maintenance, broken fence lines, illegal trails, violations of occupancy rules and degradation by disrespectful people who care neither for the sacredness nor beauty of Sandia Mountain.
We have also witnessed the destruction of cultural sites and encroachment into sensitive areas. These are places the federal government agreed to protect when Congress passed the T’uf Shur Bien Preservation Trust Area Act in 2022.
That law was the result of decades of court cases and agreements based around attempts by the Pueblo to regain access to lands originally granted to the Pueblo by the King of Spain in 1748. It was later confirmed by the U.S. Congress in 1858 under the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo when the Spanish grant, as confirmed by Congress, called for the eastern boundary of the Pueblo’s land to be set at the “main ridge” of the mountain. The 1859 survey – performed in only four days – arbitrarily meandered the foothills near the Pueblo rather than the main ridge of the Sandia Mountain area, a loss of approximately 10,000 acres from the Pueblo’s land grant.
The T’uf Shur Bien Act was an attempt to rectify the loss of about 10,000 acres from the Pueblo of Sandia’s original land grant which had extended to the ridgeline of Sandia Mountain. It allows tribal members “free and unrestricted access to the Area for traditional and cultural uses,” protects private landowners living within the claim area, defends in perpetuity the wilderness character of the area, and prevents logging, mining, and other development.
In requesting the transfer of lands from the USDA to the Interior Department, the Pueblo of Sandia held more than 75 meetings with lawmakers, neighbors, businesses, community members and others to explain why this move is important to the Pueblo.
As a sovereign nation, we have broken neither promises nor agreements. Yet, disinformation persists in the media and within some communities.
The Pueblo of Sandia is not denying access to landowners or responsible, respectful recreational users. When the land is transferred, all authorized existing uses or activities and existing public rights of way for roads and utility corridors will remain. Visitors can still enjoy the area. And the lands, waters and wildlife of Sandia Mountain will still be protected — today and for future generations.
By managing the T’uf Shur Bien Preservation Area, the Pueblo will be able to better protect its culture, traditions and way of life.
The Pueblo will also be able to better protect the mountain from future development, further degradation and even catastrophic wildfire. By offering local solutions, resources and strategies tailored to the unique cultural and physical landscape of this area, the Pueblo of Sandia can facilitate intergovernmental coordination efforts for emergency responses, public safety and law enforcement.
To retain its religious and traditional meaning to the Pueblo, Sandia Mountain must be preserved. Sandia Mountain must also be conserved and protected for the health of the Middle Rio Grande Valley and future generations. here is no one with a longer record of love and care for the mountain than those of us who have been here longest.

title: In the UK, Zopa puts heat pump financing into Hive checkout, easing the upfront hit
content:
Major home-energy upgrades can lower utility bills for years, but upfront costs often keep homeowners from following through.
In the United Kingdom, Zopa and Hive are trying to ease that burden by bringing regulated financing directly into the checkout process for heat pumps and other clean-energy equipment.
Here's what to know
TechTimes reported that Hive has added Zopa's FCA-regulated financing to its checkout, so eligible UK homeowners can stay on the site while arranging fixed monthly payments for products including heat pumps, EV chargers, smart thermostats, and solar equipment.
The timing matters as well. In July 2026, the United Kingdom's new rules for buy now, pay later credit took effect, adding stricter requirements around affordability and disclosures in a fast-growing market. Zopa was already operating under that kind of oversight because it has a full UK banking license.
The Boiler Upgrade Scheme provides up to £7,500 (~$10,193 USD) in grant support for installing a heat pump, and the program has been confirmed through March 2030. Even with that support, though, many households still have to cover thousands of pounds out of pocket.
Turning a large upfront expense into predictable monthly payments may make these projects easier to manage, especially since upgrading a heating and cooling system can be one of the most effective ways to cut energy bills and reduce exposure to rising utility costs.
If you're weighing a heating upgrade, Palmetto's Comfort Plan network can help you find efficient heating and cooling solutions for your home and connect you with vetted installers, making it easier to explore heat pumps and other HVAC options that can slash your energy bills.
More background
Hive data indicates homeowner interest in heat pumps was up 87% in 2025 versus 2024, while installations funded through the government's Boiler Upgrade Scheme doubled year over year.
Through technology acquired in its DivideBuy and Rvvup deals, the bank can plug lending into a merchant's checkout by API, provide an instant decision, and support loans ranging from £250 (~$339 USD) to £30,000 (~$40,775 USD).
Customers begin with a soft credit check that doesn't affect their credit score. Before a loan is finalized, Zopa completes a hard credit check and full affordability assessment, and the borrowing is reported to credit bureaus, meaning on-time payments can help build credit history.
These loans differ from the more lightly regulated payment deferrals many shoppers became familiar with before the July 2026 changes.
What can be done?
If you're considering a heat pump, it may be worth comparing the total cost of financing against the future savings on your heating bills. The numbers can look especially favorable if you are replacing oil or LPG heating, improving insulation, or using a tariff built for heat pumps.
If you're not ready to spend upfront, Palmetto's Comfort Plans include $0-down options that can lower your heating and cooling costs by up to 50%, plus 12 years of free maintenance. That can give you another path to efficient HVAC upgrades without absorbing a major upfront hit.
You can also pair solar panels with electric appliances, including efficient HVAC systems, to bring your utility costs even lower. EnergySage makes it easy to find the best solar system and installer for your home and budget, with potential savings of up to $10,000 on installations.
UK policymakers have said their priority is the "middle market" — households that do not qualify for means-tested grants but still cannot comfortably pay five-figure upfront costs from savings.

title: Electric scooters banned from riding on sidewalks in Kazakhstan
content:
In Kazakhstan, as of August 25, new traffic rules for electric scooter users came into effect. Now, riding them on sidewalks and pedestrian paths is prohibited — drivers must use bicycle paths and bike lanes, and in their absence, move along the right edge of the roadway or along the shoulder in cases provided for by traffic rules, reports Tengrinews.kz.
Previously, electric scooters could be used on sidewalks with a speed limit of up to 6 kilometers per hour. After the new rules came into effect, this option is no longer valid.
Riding on the roadway is permitted only for users over 18 years old who have a driver’s license of any category and a protective helmet. In dark hours, it is also necessary to use reflective elements. When crossing a pedestrian crossing, the driver must dismount.
The new requirements also apply to electric scooter rental services. Bike-sharing companies must ensure the presence of registration numbers and insurance, monitor the technical condition of the vehicles, speed, and location of scooters. Services are also required to verify the age of users and the presence of driver’s licenses in cases provided for by law.
Police and rental operators will monitor compliance with the rules. When attempting to enter a restricted zone, the system can automatically reduce the scooter’s speed and stop it. Users who violate the requirements may be subject to administrative liability.
The General Prosecutor’s Office of Kazakhstan stated that the growing popularity of personal mobility devices has led to an increase in the number of accidents.
According to the agency, electric scooter users themselves also often become victims of accidents. In Kazakhstan, 145 hit-and-run incidents involving electric scooter drivers were recorded, resulting in four deaths and nearly 300 injuries.
“These figures demonstrate that safety depends on the discipline of all road users,” emphasized the General Prosecutor’s Office.
The new rules became part of changes to traffic legislation. Authorities hope that the restrictions will help reduce the number of accidents and increase safety for both pedestrians and electric scooter users themselves.

title: Many Russians who left because of the war had to start over abroad. Some found careers they never expected.
content: People who left Russia after the start of the full-scale war have had to start their lives over from scratch. title: Lagos to host 15,000 athletes for national intermediate games
content:
Lagos is set to host about 15,000 young athletes aged between 15 and 18 for the maiden National Intermediate Games scheduled to hold from October 1 to 15, 2026.
The athletes are expected to compete in 23 compulsory and five optional sporting disciplines across 10 venues in the state.
In a post obtained from the state’s X handle on Thursday, the Chairman of the Local Organising Committee, Sam Egube, disclosed this during a media parley in Lagos, describing the games as a major platform for youth development, talent discovery and national unity.
Egube said the competition would provide opportunities to identify and nurture young athletes with the potential to advance to the National Sports Festival, continental competitions and eventually the global sporting stage.
He said, “The games will provide a strategic pathway for grassroots sports development and help us identify and nurture the next generation of Nigerian sporting talents.”
According to him, Lagos would leverage its experience in hosting major international sporting events to deliver a world-class competition.
“Lagos has built considerable experience in hosting major sporting events, and we are bringing that experience to bear to ensure a successful maiden edition,” he said.
Egube added that the games would also contribute to the local economy by creating opportunities for small businesses while allowing visitors to experience the state’s culture, hospitality and tourist attractions.
Commissioner for Youth and Social Development, Mobolaji Ogunlende, said preparations for the event were progressing rapidly, noting that the state had only 37 days to the commencement of the games at the time of the media parley.
He assured athletes, officials and visitors of a safe and memorable experience.
Ogunlende also appealed to the media to provide accurate information about the event, promote Lagos’ attractions and reassure participants of the state’s readiness to host the games.
Commissioner for Information and Strategy, Gbenga Omotoso, said the state was determined to deliver an excellent first edition.
Omotoso said the initiative was designed to bridge the gap between young sporting talents and professional athletes.
“The idea is to identify these young talents early, develop them and provide them with the opportunity to become future stars,” he said.
He disclosed that various subcommittees had been established to coordinate critical areas of the games, including security, transportation and athletes’ welfare.
Omotoso added that Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu had personally inspected some of the sporting facilities as part of preparations for the competition.
The Director-General of the Lagos State Sports Commission, Lanre Fatodu, described Lagos as a “serial trailblazer” and expressed confidence in the state’s ability to deliver a successful competition.
“Lagos is a serial trailblazer, and we will draw on our wealth of experience in hosting major sporting events to deliver a successful National Intermediate Games,” Fatodu said.
The organisers said the games would go beyond sporting competition, serving as a platform for talent discovery, youth empowerment, national unity and grassroots sports development.
With 15,000 young athletes expected to converge on Lagos, the inaugural National Intermediate Games is expected to provide a significant platform for discovering and developing Nigeria’s next generation of sporting stars.

title: Los municipios de la dana se preparan para la temporada de posibles inundaciones
content:
Los municipios de la dana se preparan para la temporada de posibles inundaciones
Comunidad Valenciana
Torrent quiere elevar la rasante de algunos cauces, Aldaia prueba sus nuevas compuertas y Paiporta prepara los imbornales para prevenir inundaciones
Los municipios afectados por la terrible dana de 2024 se preparan para la época de lluvias. Unas tormentas habituales en otoño que este año pueden ser especialmente fuertes dada la extrema temperatura del mar Mediterráneo. Los fenómenos meteorológicos de este mes de agosto dan buena cuenta de los peligros a los que un área como el golfo de València, epicentro del cambio climático, se enfrenta.
La labor más habitual y sencilla es la limpieza de los imbornales, que ya empezó a ponerse en marcha la semana pasada ante los primeros avisos naranjas por fuertes lluvias en localidades como València -el Ayuntamiento anunció la limpieza de los 76.700 que hay en la ciudad-; Paiporta, que fue uno de los municipios más golpeados por la riada de hace dos años, o Torrent. El Consistorio que preside Amparo Folgado anunció ayer que se mantienen durante estos días “los trabajos de limpieza y revisión de la red de drenaje para mejorar la evacuación del agua y prevenir posibles incidencias ante episodios de lluvias intensas”.
También este mismo Ayuntamiento ha explicado que el Ministerio de Política Territorial y Memoria Democrática ha aceptado su proyecto para reparar, reconstruir y mejorar caminos y viales afectados por la dana, con actuaciones en una docena de ámbitos rurales y periurbanos y seis puntos singulares de cruces de cauces. La actuación, con un máximo total subvencionable de casi 13 millones de euros, contempla convertir el eje Fatxardet-Barbeta en una de las principales alternativas seguras del término municipal en episodios de lluvias torrenciales y elevar la rasante de los pasos inundables para aumentar su capacidad hidráulica mediante la instalación de marcos.
Una solución similar han empleado en Chiva, otra de las poblaciones azotadas por la dana de 2024, donde se ha intentado blindar el entorno del polideportivo contra futuras inundaciones y se ha construido un nuevo muro de contención en la plataforma superior de la instalación, después de que la estructura anterior, realizada con bloque y sin cimentación, quedara descalzada por la fuerza del agua. La nueva solución, explican fuentes municipales, construida en hormigón y con cimentación adecuada, asegura la estabilidad de toda la franja que abarca desde la zona de la piscina hasta los frontones, en un tramo de cerca de 200 metros.
Por su parte, Aldaia ya realizó, hace unas semanas, una ‘prueba de compuertas’ con el objetivo de testar las nuevas barreras antiinundaciones adquiridas y calibrar el proceso de montaje de las mismas de cara a la próxima temporada de lluvias. Según explicaron desde el Consistorio, el resultado de la prueba fue “satisfactorio” y se confirmó que este dispositivo “tanto humano como material se encuentra preparado y a punto”.
Obras del Gobierno y del Consell
Sin embargo, lo que más preocupa a esta localidad de l'Horta Sud son las obras de adecuación del barranco de la Saleta. Se trata de una de las principales intervenciones frente a inundaciones de la DANA —con un presupuesto global de 150 millones— cuyo tramo principal del proyecto ya se ha sacado a licitación. Esta actuación, informó el Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico, “permitirá avanzar en la solución de un problema histórico que afecta a municipios como Aldaia, Alaquàs, Xirivella, Quart de Poblet y València pues proporcionará una salida hidráulica para las avenidas del barranco hacia el nuevo cauce del Turia”.
También el gobierno valenciano está actuando. El martes, el conseller de Agricultura, Agua, Ganadería y Pesca, Miguel Barrachina, explicaba que el ejecutivo de Pérez Llorca está ejecutando las obras de encauzamiento del barranco de Picassent a su paso por Beniparrell, una actuación dotada con cerca de 17 millones de euros que permitirá reforzar la protección frente a inundaciones en uno de los principales enclaves industriales del área metropolitana de València.
Lo hacía sin olvidar la crítica y enfatizando que se trata de una intervención que corresponde a un cauce de titularidad estatal y que la Generalitat ha asumido “ante la falta de actuación del Gobierno de España y de la Confederación Hidrográfica del Júcar”, financiándola además mediante recursos obtenidos a través de endeudamiento.

title: [Research] Transcriptome-based machine learning classification of pediatric germ cell tumors using nanopore RNA sequencing
content:
Abstract
Background
Childhood cancer comprises a heterogeneous group of diseases, with disproportionately higher mortality in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) due to limited access to molecular diagnostics. Pediatric germ cell tumors (GCTs) are rare and represent 3% of childhood cancers, showing substantial clinical and biological heterogeneity, which makes accurate subtype classification challenging. As part of an ongoing multicentric collaboration, we evaluated nanopore whole-transcriptome sequencing as a scalable approach for differentiating pediatric GCTs from other solid tumors and distinguishing their histological subtypes using a nanopore-based transcriptomic classifier.
Methods
Nanopore RNA-seq was performed on 56 pediatric tumors, including 14 germinomas/dysgerminomas/seminomas, 13 yolk sac tumors, 11 mature teratomas, seven immature teratomas, eight mixed tumors, and three embryonal carcinomas. A machine learning model was trained using their gene expression profiles and followed by independent validation.
Results
Transcriptome data enabled molecular classification, achieving 98.9% overall accuracy in distinguishing GCTs from other previously sequenced pediatric solid tumors, and 100% accuracy above the established confidence threshold of 0.8. GCT subtype classification achieved 90.3% overall accuracy and 89.8% above 0.8 prediction probability. The model showed high F1-scores and AUC values above 0.86. Consistent performance was maintained in an independent cohort, and transcriptomic profiles derived from FFPE samples showed high concordance with cryopreserved tissues, supporting the method’s applicability in routine clinical specimens.
Conclusions
These results demonstrate the diagnostic potential of the developed pipeline for GCT subtyping and support its future application in decentralized or resource-constrained healthcare systems. By enabling transcriptome-based classification with minimal infrastructure, nanopore platforms offer a promising solution for improving cancer diagnostics in LMICs.

title: Лихтенштейнде тақ мұрагерлігі бойынша ер мен әйелдің құқығы теңестірілді
content:
Лихтенштейн князьдігі тақ мұрагерлігі тәртібін өзгертті. Бұған дейін билікте отырған князьдің үлкен ұлы ғана тақ мұрагері бола алатын, енді бұл құқық отбасының тұңғыш баласына жынысына қарамастан беріледі.
Реформа туралы мұрагер князь Алоиз 15 тамызда, Лихтенштейннің Ұлттық мерекесі күні жариялады. Оның айтуынша, жаңа тәртіпті князь әулеті қажетті көпшілік дауыспен, яғни отбасы мүшелерінің үштен екісінің қолдауымен мақұлдаған.
Алоиздың түсіндіруінше, бұрынғы ер адамның басымдығына негізделген мұрагерлік жүйесі енді тұңғыштың басымдығы қағидатына ауысады. Яғни болашақта князьдің бірінші болып дүниеге келген баласы ұл я қыз екендігіне қарамастан таққа отыру құқығына ие болады.
Жаңа ереже бойынша, таққа князьдің жынысы әйел ұрпағының мұрагерлік ету құқығы Алоиздың немерелері дүниеге келген кезде іске асады. Алоиздың өз мұрагері қазірдің өзінде белгілі – 1995 жылы туған үлкен ұлы Йозеф-Венцель.
Алоиздың өзі ресми түрде тақ мұрагері саналғанымен, іс жүзінде елді басқарып отыр. 2004 жылы қазіргі князь Ханс-Адам II негізгі өкілеттіктерін ұлына беріп, оны регент етіп тағайындаған.
Бұл реформа Лихтенштейнді Еуропада таққа ер адам ғана мұрагер бола алатын соңғы монархия мәртебесінен айырды. Бұған дейін мұндай тәртіп, Ватиканды есептемегенде, осы шағын мемлекетте ғана сақталған еді.
Альпі тауларында орналасқан, шамамен 40 мың адам тұратын Лихтенштейн қоғамдағы дәстүрлі әрі консервативті ұстанымдарымен белгілі. Князьдікте әйелдерге сайлау құқығы тек 1984 жылы берілген. Ал 2025 жылы Бригитта Хаас ел тарихында алғаш рет әйел премьер-министр болып сайланған.
15 тамыз күні Қазақстан президенті Қасым-Жомарт Тоқаев тақ мұрагері Алоизді Лихтенштейн князьдігінің Ұлттық күнімен құттықтап, Қазақстан Лихтенштейнмен көп жылғы достық қарым-қатынасты және өзара құрметті жоғары бағалайтынын жеткізді деп хабарлады Ақорданың баспасөз қызметі.

title: Game-Master LLMs for Task-Based Role-Play: Supporting the Acquisition of Idiomatic Language in L2 Learning
content: Natural and idiomatic expressions are essential for fluent, everyday communication, yet many second-language learners struggle to acquire and spontaneously use casual slang despite strong formal proficiency. To address this gap, we designed and evaluated an LLM-powered, task-based role-playing game in which a GPT-4o-based Game Master guides learners through an immersive, three-phase spoken narrative. After selecting five unfamiliar slang phrases to practice, participants engage in open-ended dialogue with non-player characters; the Game Master naturally incorporates the target phrases in rich semantic contexts (implicit input enhancement) while a dedicated Practice Box provides real-time explicit tracking and encouragement. Post-session, learners receive multi-level formative feedback analyzing the entire interaction. We evaluated the system in a between-subjects study with 14 international graduate students, randomly assigned to either the RPG condition or a control condition consisting of a traditional AI-led virtual classroom. Results from an immediate post-test show that the RPG group achieved greater gains in both comprehension of the target phrases and their accurate, contextual use in sentences. A one-week delayed post-test further demonstrates that these gains are retained over time, with the RPG group showing a 21-27% improvement, indicating the effectiveness of our approach in supporting longer-term learning. Qualitative survey responses assessing engagement and perceived effectiveness further indicate that the game-based approach provided more practice opportunities and a more natural learning experience. These findings highlight the potential of narrative-driven LLM interactions in vocabulary acquisition.

title: 기부금 대신 개발자 보낸다··· 게임사 사회공헌 활동의 '진화'
content:
사회문제 표현부터 게임산업 진로까지…교육기관과 협업하는 게임사
청소년에게 AI·게임 제작 기회 주고 현직자 노하우도 공유
사람과 사람이 잇는 재능기부, 지속 가능한 사회공헌 모델로 주목


개발자들이 청소년들의 게임 제작을 돕고, 인공지능(AI)과 디지털 콘텐츠 기술을 활용한 창작교육을 실시한다. 게임과 웹툰, 애니메이션 등으로 사회문제 해결 방안을 찾는다. 바로 게임사들이 본업의 특징을 살려 펼치고 있는 새로운 모습의 사회공헌 활동이다. 게임사들이 과거 기부금 등 물질적인 지원을 넘어, 기술과 노하우를 필요한 곳과 나누며 호응을 얻고 있다.
교육기관 손잡은 엔씨·컴투스…게임 경험을 배움의 현장으로
엔씨가 후원하는 조지메이슨대학교 한국캠퍼스의 ‘소셜임팩트 디지털아트 경연대회’는 교육기관과 게임사가 학생들의 디지털 창작을 지원하는 사례다. 국내외 중·고등학생과 대학생이 저출산과 고령화, 환경, 교육 등 사회문제를 게임·애니메이션·웹툰·영상·일러스트레이션으로 풀어내고 해결 방안을 제시한다. 올해로 6회째를 맞는 이번 대회는 17일부터 참가작을 접수한다.
이 행사는 게임 제작 능력을 겨루기보다 디지털 콘텐츠를 사회문제를 해석하고 자신의 생각을 표현하는 수단으로 활용한다는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 엔씨는 2021년부터 대회를 후원해왔다. 게임사가 디지털 콘텐츠를 활용한 학생들의 사회문제 탐구와 창작 활동을 지원하는 사례다.
컴투스홀딩스는 교육기관과 게임업계를 보다 직접적으로 잇고 있다. 올해 서울디지텍고등학교와 게임·디지털 콘텐츠 분야 인재 양성을 위한 업무협약을 맺고 공모전과 교육 프로그램, 현업 멘토링, 인턴십·체험 프로그램 등을 추진하기로 했다. 학생들이 제작한 콘텐츠에는 현업 종사자의 멘토링이 제공될 계획이다.
게임사가 교육 현장에 참여하면 학생들은 최신 제작 도구와 직무를 접할 수 있고, 교육기관은 기존 수업에서 다루기 어려운 실무 경험을 보완할 수 있다. 기업의 전문성이 교육 현장의 부족한 부분을 채우는 접점이 생기는 것이다.
직접 만들고 배우고…스마일게이트·크래프톤의 창작 지원
스마일게이트는 게임과 디지털 기술을 활용한 청소년 창작 지원을 오랫동안 사회공헌의 주요 활동으로 이어왔다. 2012년 희망스튜디오를 설립한 뒤 아동·청소년과 미래세대를 대상으로 창작교육과 사회문제 해결 프로그램을 운영하고 있다.
최근에는 AI와 게임을 직접 활용하는 프로그램도 늘렸다. 지난 2월 열린 ‘팔레트 페스타 2026’에는 전국 12개 지역아동센터 아동·청소년과 멘토, 교사 등 250여명이 참여했다. 참가자들은 약 6개월 동안 AI를 활용한 콘텐츠를 비롯해 게임·영상·굿즈 등 51개 프로젝트를 직접 만들고 결과물을 공유했다. 앞서 부산정보산업진흥원과도 지역아동센터 청소년이 AI로 게임 장면과 캐릭터를 제작하는 프로그램을 운영했다.
크래프톤은 실제 게임 개발 프로젝트에 초점을 맞춘다. 2023년부터 고등학생 대상 재능기부 프로그램 ‘베터그라운드(BETTER GROUND)’를 운영하며 학생들이 직접 게임을 기획하고 개발하도록 지원하고 있다. 이 과정에서 크래프톤의 기획·프로그래밍·아트 분야 구성원들이 멘토로 참여해 제작 과정에서 필요한 실무 경험과 노하우를 전한다.
지난해까지 프로그램을 수료한 고등학생은 313명이다. 크래프톤은 이 프로그램을 구성원이 자신의 전문성과 업무 경험을 학생들과 나누는 재능기부 활동으로 운영하고 있다. 학생들은 게임 이용에 그치지 않고 아이디어를 정하고 결과물을 완성하는 전 과정을 경험한다.
돈만 내는 사회공헌은 옛말…게임사의 전문성도 나눈다
이와 같이 게임사의 사회공헌은 기부금이나 물품을 전달하는 데서 사람과 기술, 제작 경험을 나누는 쪽으로 범위가 넓어지고 있다. 기업이 보유한 전문성을 청소년과 교육 현장에 직접 연결하면서 사회공헌의 방식도 게임사마다 한층 뚜렷해지고 있다.
한 게임업계 관계자는 “게임산업은 개발, 그래픽, 스토리텔링, AI 등 다양한 직무와 기술이 결합된 만큼 사회에 나눌 수 있는 자원이 많다”며 “특히 디지털 창작 분야는 학교나 공공기관이 주도적으로 콘텐츠를 제공하기 어려운 부분이 있어 게임사의 전문성을 활용한 재능기부가 빛을 발할 수 있다”고 말했다.
이어 “사람과 사람이 직접 이어지는 사회공헌은 일회성 지원에 그치지 않고 참여자와 멘토가 경험을 주고받는 관계를 만든다”며 “이런 관계가 쌓이면 재능기부가 계속 이어질 수 있는 생태계를 만드는 데도 도움이 될 것”이라고 덧붙였다. 앞으로는 게임 제작과 콘텐츠 창작뿐 아니라 AI·디지털 윤리, 건전한 이용문화 등 게임산업이 직접 마주한 사회적 문제까지 기업의 전문성을 활용하는 사례가 더 늘어날 것으로 보인다.

title: Heroic dog saves his owner — and cat — as Spokane wildfires set home ablaze
content:
Although the Old Trails Fire in Spokane, Washington is now 100% contained, locals will be reeling from its destruction for the foreseeable future.
One such person is Donna Carberry.
Carberry’s home fell victim to the fire, but thankfully, with the help of her heroic dog, Shadow, she was able to escape with her life.
As the fire encroached on Carberry’s Spokane property, she had no idea her house was already on fire. She had lost her sense of smell as a lasting side effect of COVID-19.
But Shadow knew what to do.
“He kept trying to tell me nicely, and I wasn’t getting it,” Carberry said of Shadow.
So the three-year-old German Shepherd began slamming his body into Carberry’s back door, prompting her to investigate.
“By the time I got there and I opened the door up, my barn had already burned down,” she said.
At that point, the fire began to spread up the back steps of her house and was actively burning the side of the home.
“He literally saved my life,” Carberry said.
She knew she needed to evacuate but couldn’t catch her cat, Socksy. Once again, Shadow came to the rescue, gently putting his paw on the cat so Carberry could pick him up and carry him to safety.
As Carberry left the house, she saw even more destruction.
“Everything was on fire,” she said. “My truck and horse trailer burned up in the driveway ‘cause there was no time.”
Some good Samaritans in the neighborhood saw them struggling to leave the home and helped them move to safer ground on a nearby road.
“They took me over to Trails Road and sat me and the kitty and my puppy on the side of the road,” she recounted. “And it was, of course, just pandemonium.”
She decided to sit and wait it out a bit. But when she saw someone else evacuating her horses, the stranger stopped to ask how long she had been there.
“I said, ‘since noon on Saturday,’” Carberry said. “And she said, ‘Honey, it’s 8:00 on Sunday night.’”
The woman loaded Carberry and her pets in her truck and brought them to a Red Cross relief center.
Carberry had fallen during her speedy evacuation and was in need of medical attention. To recover, she would need to remain in a wheelchair, making her temporarily unable to care for her pets.
A neighbor stepped in to care for Socksy, while nonprofit Best Friends Animal Society, which was on-site at the relief center, quickly made arrangements to care for Shadow.
The nonprofit, which is leading the companion animal response for the Washington State Pet Task Force, is taking care of Shadow while Carberry recovers, ensuring he will have all the veterinary care he may need.
The organization has also helped Carberry and Shadow relocate to a safe place to stay while they rebuild.
“Best friends stepped up and stepped in and started taking care of Shadow for me,” Carberry said in a video for the organization.
“By … taking care of him, you’re taking care of me.”
“I don’t care about my stuff,” she added. “I just care about [Shadow].”

title: 从二手设备起家 他们练就纳米科技的"绝活儿"
content: 苏州独墅湖科教创新区内，藏着一个“大家伙”——中国科学院苏州纳米技术与纳米仿生研究所（以下简称苏州纳米所）纳米加工平台。 一支136人的团队、超10000平方米的实验空间、300余台套国际先进设备、支撑了100余项国家重大科研任务攻关……在微纳米尺度间精雕细琢，他们练就了一手纳米科技的“绝活儿”。 “把线宽精度控制在纳米级，相当于在头发丝上刻出万里长城的纹路。”苏州纳米所微纳加工技术创新团队负责人曾中明告诉记者，回望过往20年一次次突破技术垄断的艰辛历程，他颇为感慨，永远要有“吃得苦、霸得蛮”的精神。 钱不够？二手设备也能用 当时针拨回2008年，我国半导体产业出现近20年来首次负增长。 “当时国外的芯片技术发展非常迅猛，而我国也面临着多样难题，技术人才也严重匮乏。”团队创始人张宝顺告诉《中国科学报》，他深刻感到，发展中国的芯片产业必须发展先进的微纳加工技术，“培养芯片高端制造的人才，支撑我国新一代信息技术的发展，并推动产业转型升级。” 要怎么实现这一目标呢？团队提出一个大胆的想法：建立一个我国工艺先进的微纳加工技术公共平台，成为技术创新和人才培养的“基地”。 说干就干。团队的想法得到中国科学院苏州纳米所的支持，但要想让这一“小目标”落地生根，还有不少难题摆在他们面前。 “首先就是钱。”张宝顺告诉记者，当时芯片行业发展滞缓，再加上芯片制造投入高、回报慢的特点，不少人都对芯片行业的发展持观望态度，“要找到足够的资金支持非常困难。” 很幸运的是：他们的想法得到了当地政府的大力支持。 “我们和江苏省和苏州工业园区交流后，对方非常认可这个想法，也愿意投入前期经费。”张宝顺告诉记者，拿到了首批6000万的“巨款”，纳米加工平台终于有了启动资金。“我们可以采购一些设备，慢慢搭建平台的‘骨架’了。” 由于半导体设备的价值普遍昂贵，为了能拥有更加多样的工艺能力，团队做了大量的调研工作，非常艰辛。 “没办法，我们从国外采购了一批别人淘汰的二手设备，再组织我们团队的工程师，自己慢慢摸索进行翻新。”想起十多年前筚路蓝缕的日子，张宝顺感叹，“这一优良传统延续到现在，我们也建成了一支具有芯片制造设备维修，维护和改造能力的队伍，成了纳米加工平台发展的中坚力量。” 有了设备，该找谁来使用呢？张宝顺又犯了难。“当时国家缺乏微纳加工技术相关人才，我们能给的工资也不高，只能去找一些刚毕业的年轻人，在动手实践的过程里慢慢摸索。”张宝顺说。 通过严格的选拔和手把手的培养，2009年，纳米加工平台建设完成正式对外开放，首批十余位成员担负平台的运行工作。 从1000到10000 荣获2025年全国先进工作者表彰的张晓东就是纳米加工平台的首批成员。 “引进人才是我们平台的第一步，也是最重要的一步工作。”张宝顺告诉记者，然而，首批成员中多数是刚毕业的硕士生和博士生，“没有足够的经验，我们就用‘师傅带徒弟’的方式，从知识到技能，手把手进行指导。” 同时，团队还定期聘请专家进行指导，让成员们及时迅速地学习微纳加工领域的前沿技术。“从新手到熟练人员的时间取决于不同人的态度和能力，但我们在培养中最重视的是对待工作的态度。”曾中明强调。 从面试环节，曾中明就格外重视寻找志同道合的人。“我们最看重的不只是能力，更重要的是对平台和团队文化的认可，这样才能培养真正团结奋进的队伍。”张晓东也是在师傅们的言传身教下，一边学、一边做，十余年如一日，慢慢从工艺员成长为技术骨干。 首批设备和成员就位，纳米加工平台开始有条不紊地开展工作。“我们坚信，我国未来一定会实现产业的智能化、数字化转型升级，微纳加工技术就是其中重点。”曾中明告诉《中国科学报》，因此，纳米加工平台成立之初，就致力于建设成我国实力强大的微纳加工技术创新平台，以开放共享的姿态、真诚饱满的热情为半导体行业的发展注入新活力。 但要想“致千里”，首个“跬步”就是“实现收支平衡，再扩大规模”，曾中明说，初期“不为人知”的纳米加工平台，客户多以大学老师、创业团队为主，帮助他们进行技术成果转化，慢慢地，纳米加工平台的名气越来越响。 后来，核心技术自主可控的重要性愈发凸显，一些大型企业也主动找到纳米加工平台，“2018年，纳米加工平台进入快速发展阶段。一个俄罗斯专家看到我们发表的论文主动来寻求合作，凭借过硬的技术、良好的交流和规划，我们成功拿到了这个国际合作项目。”曾中明自豪地说。 目前，纳米加工平台的超净实验室从建设初期的1000平方米扩展到目前的10000余平方米，各类半导体工艺加工设备300余台套，团队每年支撑数百家高校、科研院所和企业进行科学研究和技术开发，推动相关产业增加产值数十亿元。 “吃得苦、霸得蛮” “吃得苦、霸得蛮”，这是曾中明的口头禅，也是他对微纳团队十多年攻关的概括。 “我们团队最看重成员的品德，我经常和大家说，要想把科研干好，必须提高自身素养。”曾中明告诉记者，团队始终坚信，只有拥有好的精神风貌，才能敏锐捕捉前沿科技，扎实做好当下功夫。 现在，除了“师傅带徒弟”的手把手教学外，曾中明还格外强调“学习和再教育”。“半导体制造行业，尤其是微纳加工技术发展、迭代非常迅速，如果不能在实践中学习，不能在工作中接受新的东西，很快我们的工艺技术就会落后。”曾中明正了正神色，所以微纳团队坚持定期邀请专家研讨，并将优秀的成员送出去培训，“培养年轻科研人员的动手能力和前沿科技视野。” 注重年轻人才培养，是曾中明的“先手棋”。 “在国家的高度重视下，我国微纳加工技术得到迅速发展，但目前制造设备、高端人才储备等方面仍有提升空间。”曾中明表示，尤其人才培养更关注书本能力，在动手实践方面稍显薄弱，“这也是我们团队重点攻关的方向。” 经过十余年的培养，以张晓东为代表的年轻一代科研人员逐渐成为团队骨干，以身作则传递着“劳模工匠”精神。 此外，曾中明还希望能进一步加强与相关企业的合作。“好技术不能藏在实验室里，要成为产业升级的‘催化剂’。”这也是团队始终秉持的服务理念。 “现在我们建成了国内开放程度最高、工艺能力领先、具有特色的纳米技术公共服务平台，涵盖半导体制造的多道工序，为新一代信息科技发展输送了大量高技术和高技能人才。”谈及十余年间团队的累累硕果，曾中明笑着说，“但我更希望大家能有吃苦耐劳、‘坐得住冷板凳’的精神，以及树立终身学习的目标。” 从2009年纳米加工平台正式向社会敞开怀抱，经历16载春秋，团队从十几人壮大到120余人，超净实验室从一层楼扩展到四层楼，营收从1000万增加到1.5亿，团队成员累计荣获“全国五一劳动奖章”“中国科学院关键技术人才”“江苏省绝技绝活”等各级荣誉称号50余人次。他的心里感慨万千。 “我希望未来能进一步提升我国微纳加工技术，让纳米加工平台真正成为全国，乃至全球具有重要影响力的纳米技术公共服务平台。”曾中明说，“这是我们始终坚持的愿景。” 微纳加工技术创新团队。受访者供图 微纳加工技术创新团队。受访者供图

title: The clinical value of PDCA cycle led by clinical pharmacists in optimizing the use of antimicrobial drugs in pediatric departments of primary hospitals
content: BackgroundPediatric departments in primary hospitals face challenges such as insufficient diagnostic capabilities, weak management systems, and a lack of guidance on medication use. These factors have led to persistently high rates of antimicrobial use and misuse, which seriously jeopardize the safety of pediatric care in primary hospitals. Clinical pharmacists play a key role in ensuring the appropriate use of medications. However, in primary hospitals, their role is often marginalized or entirely absent.ObjectiveThis study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a multidisciplinary antimicrobial stewardship intervention led by clinical pharmacists in promoting the appropriate use of antimicrobials among pediatric outpatients and inpatients at a primary care hospital.MethodThis study established a multidisciplinary team led by clinical pharmacists and conducted a quality improvement study in the pediatric department of a primary care hospital. ChatGPT was introduced as a brainstorming tool during the root cause analysis process. Interventions included daily embedded ward rounds, electronic prescription preauthorization, and structured training. After two Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycles, changes in primary and secondary outcome measures were compared between the control group and the two intervention groups.ResultsAfter two PDCA cycles, the outpatient antimicrobial usage rate decreased from 38.81 to 27.14%, the intravenous infusion rate decreased from 28.29 to 20.04%, and the per-patient medication cost decreased from ¥68.50 to ¥49.73 (p < 0.0001). For inpatients, the antibiotic usage rate decreased from 90.92 to 78.36%, the antibiotic intensity decreased from 82.24 to 49.94, and the perpatient medication cost decreased from 281.94 Yuan to 130.90 Yuan (p < 0.0001). The rate of inappropriate prescribing among outpatients decreased from 34.75 to 12.08%, and among inpatients, it decreased from 40.30 to 13.42% (p < 0.0001). No statistically significant change was observed in the average length of hospital stay (p > 0.05). A standardized prescribing workflow was established.ConclusionAntimicrobial utilization decreased following implementation of the intervention. Tailored to the practical realities and characteristics of primary healthcare settings, it demonstrates both feasibility and replicability. It provides evidence-based guidance and a management framework for advancing rational drug use in children at the primary care level.

title: Liberia: Liberia Agrees to Receive 1,200 U.S. Deportees
content:
MONROVIA — The following is the full text of a statement issued by the Government of Liberia announcing an arrangement with the United States to receive up to 1,200 third-country nationals being removed from the United States. The Daily Observer has submitted questions to Information Minister Jerolinmek M. Piah seeking further clarification on the terms, legal basis, costs and implementation of the arrangement. His responses will be published when received.
The Government of Liberia announces an arrangement with the Government of the United States of America for the dignified, safe and timely transfer from the United States of America to the Republic of Liberia, of persons to be removed from the United States. The arrangement is based on an exchange of notes between the two countries on September 4 and September 10, 2025.
Liberia intends to accept up to 1,200 persons to be transferred from the United States of America within a year. The persons to be transferred to Liberia are Third Country Nationals, some of whom may wish to seek asylum in Liberia. Under the arrangement, those to be transferred from the United States of America to Liberia will include citizens or nationals of African and Western hemisphere countries who are medically authorized to travel.
The Government of Liberia announces further that the first batch of 20 individuals to be transferred to Liberia under the arrangement will arrive in the country on Thursday, August 20, 2026. Meanwhile the Government has made the necessary preparations for their reception at the Roberts International Airport and for their stay in Liberia.
